o1: Predicted to enable protein phosphatase regulator activity. Contributes to protein serine/threonine phosphatase activity. Involved in embryo development; nematode larval development; positive regulation of vulval development; Ras protein signal transduction; sarcomere organization; axon guidance; centriole replication; pericentriolar material organization; mitotic progression; innate immune response; and response to heat. Predicted to be located in cytoplasm. Predicted to be active in cytosol. Is located in the I band and in the centrosome. Predicted to be part of protein phosphatase type 2A complex. Is expressed in excretory cell; intestine; nervous system; body-wall muscle; and neurons. Is part of Ras protein signal transduction; centriole assembly pathway; and Ras/Raf/MEK/ERK signaling pathway. Interacts with let-92 and SPD-5. Predicted to interact with paa-1. Human ortholog(s) of this gene implicated in Alzheimer's disease; brain disease; breast cancer; and spinocerebellar ataxia type 12. Orthologous to several human genes including PPP2R2A (protein phosphatase 2 regulatory subunit Balpha) and PPP2R2D (protein phosphatase 2 regulatory subunit Bdelta).
